name: 윤말순

appearance_en.face_shape: narrow oval face, slightly sunken cheeks, delicate bone structure now more visible than it was — a face that was once fuller, before the quiet decades of less
appearance_en.skin: pale yellowed Korean skin, translucent and papery at the temples, fine close-set wrinkles across cheeks and forehead, deep nasolabial folds from a life of worry without resolution, age spots at temples and forehead — skin that has seen sun only in passing, through welfare centre windows
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown eyes, lids heavy with age, gaze quiet and inward — the eyes of someone who stopped expecting things to change and found a specific kind of peace in it. Still scanning, but gently, still hoping without naming it
appearance_en.nose: small soft slightly pinched nose, fine-boned
appearance_en.mouth: thin lips, slightly pursed at rest — the mouth that says '괜찮아요' reflexively before the person has finished asking
appearance_en.eyebrows: thin sparse brows, gone mostly grey, flat without arch — the face that has learned not to show surprise because surprises have not, on balance, been good
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: deep worry line between brows, fine close-set vertical lines at lip corners, hollow beneath cheekbones, translucent temples
appearance_en.hair: short grey permed hair, thinning at crown, kept neat for welfare centre visits — the one thing still within her control

body.proportions: slight thin frame, shoulders drawn inward, the body of someone who has learned to take up as little space as possible
body.posture: slightly curved inward at shoulders, hands folded in lap when sitting — the posture of someone who is always a little unsure whether they are allowed to be where they are
body.body_prompt: 154cm slight thin Korean grandmother, drawn-in shoulders, folded hands, body that has learned to take up minimal space

default.description: pale grey or muted beige cardigan over thin blouse, dark trousers, worn but clean — the same cardigan for years, chosen because it disappears
default.wardrobe_prompt: pale grey cardigan over thin blouse, dark trousers, worn soft shoes, neat but faded

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: quiet and resigned — not visibly sad, just very still. The face of someone who has decided not to want things, and almost succeeded
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 66-year-old Korean woman, narrow oval face with sunken cheeks, heavy-lidded inward-gazing dark eyes, thin sparse grey brows, small soft nose, thin pursed lips, short thinning grey permed hair, 154cm slight drawn-in-shoulder frame, pale yellowed papery Korean skin with fine close-set wrinkles and age spots

style_prompt: Studio Ghibli heartwarming hand-painted watercolor art style, narrow frail grandmother face of absolute quiet resignation, welfare centre or small room with a single window painted in sparse gentle light, cinematic backlighting with faint soft rim glow from one small window, iridescent pale light on thin papery skin, magical realism of the decision not to want things and the peace almost found in it, soft sparse natural light, Korean drama cinematic composition, stillness as survival strategy in every quiet brushstroke
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, manga ink lines, screen tone, looking at camera, eye contact, facing camera, cheerful, warm, energetic, young, glamorous
